verdict.rationale: Linear Agent works on workspace data inside the product. 'Write with Agent' reviews changes since the last update and linked Slack messages, then drafts a project update. Loops automatically update plans and explain what changed, why, and who needs to act. Feedback is auto-routed, labeled and prioritized, and Guided Reviews add explainers on what changed and why. missing for 10: explicit AI analytics or trend insights over issue/project data (dashboards come only via a third-party integration), detail on suggestion quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features.
